description:
This protocol performs cherrypicking from source to target plates as specified in an input CSV file. The protocol parses the CSV for slots to load the source and target plates. Only non-zero volume transfers are carried out for efficiency, and the user is prompted to refill tipracks if necessary.



To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

P50 Single-channel electronic pipette
P300 8-channel electronic pipette
Opentrons 300µl Pipette tips
Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL
Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set
USA Scientific 12-Well Reservoir, 22mL



Deck Layout

Slot 1: Opentrons 300µl Pipette tips (for P50 Single-Channel)

Slot 2: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (ELISA plate A)

Slot 3: USA Scientific 12-Well Reservoir, 22mL

Slot 4: Opentrons 300µl Pipette tips (for P300 8-Channel)

Slot 5: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (ELISA plate B)

Slot 6: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (1st Dilution Plate)

Slot 7: Opentrons 300µl Pipette tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips) (for P300 8-Channel)

Slot 8: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (ELISA plate C)

Slot 9: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack containing 2mL Tubes

Slot 10: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (2nd Dilution Plate)

Slot 11: Corning 96-Well Plate, Flat 360µL (ELISA plate D)
